> ### Internal subroutine · Fixed Quality Gates · User stage: Results
> - **Consumes:** repo, approved/frozen artifacts, managed analysis execution,
>   and the current Results revision's report artifacts.
> - **Produces:** `data_qa.json` and a documented manual-gate decision.
> - **When:** data QA follows the Phase-10 inventory; fixed render QA runs after
>   every agent-authored report revision.
> - **Next:** a pass means **ready for review**, not uploaded. Continue the
>   Phase-11 preview/revision loop; only helper validation followed by explicit
>   public `paperclip upload`
>   may upload.

## Quality Gates

### Executable data gate (mandatory)

Run the release-matched data QA validator for this guided project:

```bash
cd <topic_dir>
paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis-scale data-qa --dir .
```

It writes `data_qa.json` and must exit 0 with `status:"pass"`. Do not
hand-write this file. The validator checks the guided dynamic contracts:
`collection_spec.json`, `planned_outputs.json`, `evidence_proposal.json`,
`harmonization_map.json`, verified-findings provenance, and common artifacts
(analysis, synthesis, protocol, PRISMA, search log, extraction audit). It does
not auto-detect or run a legacy data-QA branch. Guided verification accounting
must have zero active `[?]`, `[!]`, and `[X]`.

Warnings such as suspicious round symmetric CIs require source review and a
recorded resolution even when the script exits 0.

### Managed analysis execution gate (mandatory)

Before the manual gates below, verify that Phase 7 actually ran:

```bash
paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis-scale validate-results --dir <topic_dir> --json
```

This must exit 0 and confirm `analysis.json` was produced by the managed
runner. If `analysis_project.json` exists but `validate-results` fails,
`analysis.json` was hand-written or stale — return to Phase 7 and re-run.
Never proceed to synthesis, rendering, or publication with fabricated
analysis results.

### Manual methodological gates

Executable checks cannot decide substantive appropriateness. Confirm:

- [ ] Stage-1 schema determination used the bundled structured discovery schema
  with `map`; free-text brainstorming was not treated as the approval artifact.
- [ ] Every approved discovered field/option has current-paper original wording,
  an absolute readable source path, and a canonical line/range.
- [ ] Open-world products, detailed outcomes, cohorts, assays, and complications
  use open or hybrid vocabularies rather than a falsely comprehensive enum.
- [ ] Background-only concepts were not promoted into focal project options.
- [ ] After the representative pilot, the user received the exact final schema
  files, a plain-language revision summary, and inspectable paths, then
  explicitly chose approve-and-lock before `schema-lock` or scaling.
- [ ] Search scale is justified by the field, planned outputs, observed
  category/unit coverage, and marginal yield—not a universal card quota.
- [ ] Every protocol-eligible verifiable source was searched with explicit `-s`;
  every source-specific omission is justified.
- [ ] Search/extraction alternated in logged waves until marginal yield was low
  and no plausible outcome/population/intervention/citation gap remained, or a
  hard stop was reached with residual gaps disclosed.
- [ ] Every included paper was screened in full text; every full-text exclusion
  has one protocol-grounded reason.
- [ ] Scaled extraction used the current locked optimized schema and categorical
  registry; every map manifest records matching schema/model/prompt/code
  provenance.
- [ ] Every paper attempted the complete structured schema first. A timeout,
  size, formatting, validation, or material-completeness failure routed the
  whole paper to exhaustive extraction.
- [ ] Stable IDs and links among study context, analysis units, findings,
  definitions, and comparisons resolve within each complete paper.
- [ ] Exhaustive fallback remained bound to the same project schema and did not
  silently change fields, options, scope, or source-location rules.
- [ ] `repo_staging.json` reconciles all successful structured and exhaustive
  fallback outputs, has no unresolved blockers, and its add counts match the
  repo before verification.
- [ ] Every verified numeric value appears in readable source lines or a
  text-based supplement. Figure-only and image-table values are recorded as
  `missing_visual_evidence`, not represented as line-verified findings.
- [ ] Every normalized numeric/integer value matches digits or unambiguous
  number words in its own `as_reported` source wording (allowing only explicit
  percent/proportion ×100 conversion); no value borrows a different number
  from the same passage.
- [ ] Outcome direction, unit, comparator, time point, and measure were
  harmonized without changing reported values.
- [ ] Correlated effects, duplicate cohorts, review/primary overlap, repeated
  time points, and subgroups follow `dependency_rules`.
- [ ] **Only for approved pooled quantitative/pairwise outputs:** heterogeneity
  is interpreted for each pooled group; pairwise publication-bias diagnostics
  use Egger only at k≥10, and leave-one-out only when applicable at k≥3.
- [ ] **Only when the approved pairwise analysis plan requires these
  estimators:** REML–KH and DL results are both reported and material
  discrepancies noted. Otherwise report the approved estimator/diagnostics,
  not a forced REML–KH/DL pair.
- [ ] **Only when the protocol requests an applicable certainty assessment:**
  GRADE (or the approved domain-appropriate framework) is reviewed against
  actual assessments with rationale for its applicable domains.
- [ ] Descriptive synthesis/evidence-map outputs mark these inferential checks
  not applicable with rationale; they are not blocked for lacking
  heterogeneity, Egger, leave-one-out, REML–KH/DL, or GRADE outputs.
- [ ] Every Claude/reviewer assessment and proposal decision retains provenance;
  reviewer-only judgment is not presented as source-reported evidence.
- [ ] `verified_findings.json` was generated by the universal exporter, contains
  `generator:"gxl_paperclip.meta_analysis.export_verified"`, and was never
  handwritten or manually repaired.
- [ ] `evidence_review.json` was refreshed with
  `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis-scale review evidence
  --refresh --dir <topic_dir> --json`; it was not handwritten and contains no
  removed, errored, pending, or rejected map values.
- [ ] The synthesis distinguishes robust findings, fragile findings,
  contradictions/boundary conditions, and limitations without overclaiming.
- [ ] PRISMA 2020 items are addressed and flow counts agree with evidence flow.

The cross-file consistency reference is **Phase 8e**.

### Render gate (mandatory after Phase 11)

- [ ] The agent authored a self-contained `index.html` using the release
  renderer code as reference.
- [ ] `paperclip routines run paperclip-meta-analysis-scale render-qa --dir
  <topic_dir>` exits 0 and
  `render_qa.json.status == "pass"`.
- [ ] Every rendered study/effect links to `citations.gxl.ai#L<lines>` or a DOI
  fallback; no empty declared figure is present.

Any failed gate blocks Phase 12 upload.
